about: 300 chat messages sampled at random from the demo chats and labeled BEFORE any scorer was run on them. Rule: label the affect the words themselves express (thanks/excitement/affection/laughing banter = positive; worry/panic/anger/hurt/complaining = negative; information, logistics, questions, cold accusations = neutral), not the situation. One labeler, single messages read without context, so treat small differences as noise. 'dev' may be studied and tuned on; 'test' is only for the final number.
labeler: the assistant that built this project
